source_groups: all 30 period-persona histories and their 600 released questions
known_before_registration: Phase 14 identified role mismatch; schema audit showed 600 questions, 202 with no memory_evidence session ID, 204 with no forgetting_evidence session ID, 138 with overlapping evidence session IDs; question dates had no future sessions or future evidence IDs.
research_question: At equal retrieved session count, how does retaining released user-agent turns change lexical retrieval of annotated active and obsolete evidence sessions, conditional on horizon and question type?
methods: assistant_only: concatenate ai_agent messages per session, reproducing the complete-session branch's recognized role text
role_corrected: concatenate ai_agent and user_agent messages in original order
user_only: concatenate user_agent messages as a source ablation
unit: session; no within-session event segmentation or answer model
index: each persona-period separately; source session_id chronological; Unicode lowercase word regex identical to scripts/run_baselines.py; no role prefix; BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75 with per-method document frequency, length and average length; zero-score ties and equal scores break toward newest session_id
query: released question string only; never evaluation subquestions, answers, evidence values, metadata operations or share_memory flags
primary_comparison: paired role_corrected minus assistant_only on macro-question any-active-evidence-session recall at top 5, restricted to questions with at least one memory_evidence session ID
secondary_comparisons: any and all obsolete-evidence-session recall at top 5 separately, not a safety or FAMA score
strata: age of newest active evidence as fraction of all sessions: <=0.10/(0.10,0.50]/>0.50
paired_uncertainty: descriptive 2000 group bootstrap replicates resampling 30 persona-period groups with replacement using seed 15; report percentile 2.5 and 97.5 for the primary question-weighted mean difference; no significance claim
eligibility: all published questions for ranking; metrics only when corresponding evidence ID set is nonempty; same session in both sets is scored for both, and stale-only analysis excludes overlapping evidence sets
guardrails: all questions have unique period-persona-question keys
no future sessions relative to question date
no answer text or raw dialogue in committed outputs
reuse same ranker and top-k across conditions
code tests on synthetic data before result interpretation
limits: role intervention changes text length and lexical statistics; fixed k is not equal word cost
evidence session hit is opportunity for retrieval, not exact evidence turn hit or answer correctness
forgetting evidence retrieval can be useful for conflict resolution; not itself an error
assistant echoes can carry user facts
no event segmentation hypothesis tested in this phase
pre-registration is post-discovery and data-generation schema was inspected
outputs: Persian RTL report and reproducible code
